author: cms-sw
body: CMSSW `aarch64`  IBs are failing as many `cicc` processes run in parallel (each requiring over 5-6GB of resident memory). See more details in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmsdist/pull/10889#issuecomment-5927859288 . This PR proposes to drop nvcc paralel compilation flags for non-x86_64 archs.
title: Avoid parallel nvcc compilation for aarch64
